title: Authored events
description: The punctuation the cards don't do: a seasonal festival, a storm, DL's birthday (plan section 2, 'Layer 3: the event engine'). Where a card is drawn under a pacing target, an authored event becomes eligible when its own `trigger` is met, and while it runs it takes priority over any card named in `priorityOver` so a small random card never steps on something with a more interesting result. Reuses the card schema's `hooks`, `storybook`, `moment`, `beat` blocks and predicate shape (events.schema.json) rather than redefining them.

timeScale.description: Same shape and meaning as events.schema.json's timeScale; repeated here so this file is self-contained and does not need farm.json open beside it to make sense of durationSimMinutes.

trigger.description: How this event becomes eligible. Three shapes, picked by `kind`, matching the issue's three: a predicate list (every entry in `all` must hold, same predicate shape a card's `conditions` uses); a fixed point in the season calendar; or a Ledger stock crossing a threshold. `predicates` and `stockThreshold` both carry their own `cooldownSimDays` because, unlike a card, an authored event has no `limits` block — a predicate list or a stock level can stay true for a long time (a whole drought, a whole winter), and without a cooldown the event would fire again the very next sim-minute.

oneOf.description: A specific day in the nine-sim-day season cycle (balance/farm.json outsideRules.season.realDays; clock.dayCount mod 9, PROPOSED to sim on #40 same as v1 proposed recentWeather — there is no calendar concept in the sim yet, only the four-season wheel and a running day count). Recurs every time that season comes round.

variables.description: Authored parameters a card does not get (plan section 2): named values this event's own hooks and storybook read, that no other event shares. Deliberately open — unlike the rest of this schema, `additionalProperties` is not false here, because every authored event needs a different bag of them. Documented per event in docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md.

priorityOver.description: Card ids, or bare parameter names such as a hook target (`mood`, `weather`), this event outranks while it runs: a named card does not fire, and a named parameter is not touched by any other card's hooks, until this event ends.
